description:
Blocked on the suite actually being green, not on T-012 being closed. T-012 took the Modules suite from 463 failures to 274 by fixing the harness, and clustered the rest into ISS-010 (command-signature drift, 61), ISS-011 (schema drift, ~25), ISS-012 (Pest skip() in PHPUnit classes, 10), ISS-013 (empty test file), plus assertion failures spread across TaskControllerTest, TaskViewRendererTest, ConnectionManagerTest and the Livewire tests.

Moving the suite into defaultTestSuite now would make `composer test` and CI red. Do it after those issues close, and re-measure coverage rather than reusing the recorded 43.5% -> 44.2%.
title: Move Modules into the default test suite once green
